event: UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs. Malott

items.fight_news: Joaquin Buckley and Mike Malott headline in Edmonton on October 17. Buckley enters at 21-8 and Malott at 14-2-1, with the No. 10 and No. 13 welterweights meeting in a non-title main event.

Buckley is looking to end a two-fight losing streak after facing Kamaru Usman and Sean Brady. Before those setbacks, he won six consecutive welterweight bouts, including stoppages of Stephen Thompson and Colby Covington.

Malott has won four straight since his loss to Neil Magny. His latest victory was a third-round stoppage of Gilbert Burns in April, and Edmonton marks his second consecutive main-event assignment in Canada.
The October 17 prelims begin at 5pm Eastern and the main card at 8pm Eastern. In India, those starts are October 18 at 2:30am and 5:30am respectively. The United States broadcast is on Paramount+.

Erin Blanchfield returns after submitting Tracy Cortez in November 2025. She previously defeated Rose Namajunas in Edmonton, giving the American another opportunity to build on a successful appearance in the same city.

Jasmine Jasudavicius rebounded from her loss to Manon Fiorot with a unanimous-decision victory over Karine Silva in April. Blanchfield is her next chance to establish herself among the division's leading championship candidates.

Blanchfield brings an 8-1 UFC record into this matchup, while Jasudavicius is 9-3 in the promotion. With Natalia Silva having won the flyweight title earlier this month, this meeting carries significant contender stakes.

bouts.title: Kyle Nelson vs Cristian Perez Gonzalez

items.fight_news: Kyle Nelson returns after Terrance McKinney stopped him in 24 seconds in March. He had beaten Matt Frevola by unanimous decision the previous October, making this a chance to restart his lightweight momentum.

Cristian Perez Gonzalez makes his UFC debut against an opponent who first entered the promotion in 2018. The Mexican lightweight receives a veteran test on a main card featuring several established Canadian competitors.

Marc-Andre Barriault enters at 17-11 after consecutive decision losses to Shara Magomedov and Michal Oleksiejczuk. The Canadian middleweight's last win was a first-round knockout of Bruno Silva in May 2025.

Kyle Daukaus looks to rebound after Bo Nickal stopped him in June. His return to the UFC had begun with quick wins over Michel Pereira and Gerald Meerschaert, bringing him back into contention for meaningful middleweight assignments.

Louis Jourdain earned his UFC contract by submitting Magno Dias in the third round of their September 2025 Contender Series bout. He joins older brother Charles on the roster and now faces Timmy Cuamba at bantamweight.

Cuamba returns after a second-round submission loss to Benardo Sopaj in May. That defeat followed victories over Roberto Romero and ChangHo Lee, giving the American a chance to resume the progress he made in 2025.

Mandel Nallo seeks his first UFC win after Jai Herbert stopped him in April. The Canadian lightweight earned his contract with a first-round finish of Samuel Silva on Contender Series and enters this assignment at 14-4.

Nate Landwehr moves into this lightweight matchup after three consecutive stoppage defeats at featherweight. His most recent loss came against Cub Swanson in April, making Edmonton a rebuilding opportunity for the longtime action fighter.
Tanner Boser returns after a second-round stoppage loss to Gokhan Saricam in April. The Bonnyville-born heavyweight gets another Canadian appearance as he looks for a win in his second UFC stint.

Jhonata Diniz brings a 9-2 MMA record and a substantial professional kickboxing background. His two MMA defeats have come inside the UFC, and this matchup pairs him with an opponent who has competed professionally since 2012.

Julien Leblanc returns after Robert Valentin submitted him in the first round of his April UFC debut. The Canadian middleweight previously won a regional championship against former UFC fighter Darion Weeks.
Nick Galanti earned his UFC contract with a 35-second knockout of Carlos Petruzzella in August. The former regional middleweight champion now faces Leblanc in his first UFC appearance.
Javad Mahjoub brings an Olympic judo background to his UFC debut. Born in Iran and later based in Canada, he competed for the Refugee Olympic Team in Tokyo before pursuing his MMA career.

Joel Faglier is also scheduled for his first UFC appearance. At 25, he faces the 35-year-old Mahjoub in a heavyweight pairing that gives both newcomers an immediate opportunity to establish themselves.

Katlyn Cerminara returns for her first fight since a March 2024 decision loss to Maycee Barber. The former flyweight title challenger enters at 18-6 and has faced many of the division's leading names.
Mackenzie Stiller makes her UFC debut as the replacement for Jamey-Lyn Horth. She submitted Kendra McIntyre by first-round armbar in February and has also appeared on The Ultimate Fighter.
Chad Anheliger returns after a November 2024 decision loss to Cody Gibson. The Canadian bantamweight enters at 13-8 and previously defeated Charalampos Grigoriou over three rounds.

Steven Koslow returns to the UFC after Cameron Saaiman stopped him in December 2022. His six professional wins all came by first-round submission, while his only UFC appearance reached the third round.

Melissa Croden enters at 8-3 after a unanimous-decision win over Daria Zhelezniakova in April. That result followed a loss to Luana Santos, giving the Canadian bantamweight a chance to build consecutive UFC victories.

Chelsea Chandler returned to the win column by submitting Priscila Cachoeira with a first-round armbar in June. She enters at 7-4 after previously dropping consecutive fights to Yana Santos and Joselyne Edwards.

Croden has six knockout victories, while Chandler has wins by both strikes and submission. Both have experience beyond the UFC, with Croden having challenged for a regional title over five rounds and Chandler developing through an all-women's promotion.
Cody Chovancek makes his UFC debut after developing on the Canadian regional circuit. The Niagara Top Team bantamweight joins a card also featuring teammates Mike Malott and Jasmine Jasudavicius.

SuYoung You returns after Elijah Smith submitted him in March. The Road to UFC bantamweight tournament winner had previously earned decision victories over Jieleyisi Baergeng, AJ Cunningham, and Xiao Long.
